sites.rationale: L4 states '3xHA positioned at position S898 in ECL4 of CFTR' in a Gibson assembly construct of full-length CFTR. Python confirms seq[897]='S' (position 898) and seq[896]='H' (position 897); 'at position S898' means the tag is inserted before S898, i.e., insert_after_residue=897. Position 897 is 18 residues from TM7 end (879) and 21 residues from TM8 start (918). This is a distinct junction from the N901 FLAG site (L1/L2), 4 residues upstream in the same ECL4. L12 corroborates that HA tagging in this loop does not disrupt folding or trafficking. Full-length CFTR generated by Gibson assembly from pBI-CMV2-CFTR with a triple HA tag (3xHA) gene block positioned at S898 in ECL4, creating the TMD2-3HA construct. The paper names S898 as the position, which by standard insertion convention places the tag after residue 897 (H), immediately before S898.

sources.claim: The TMD2-3HA construct was generated by Gibson assembly from pBI-CMV2-CFTR and a gene block consisting of triple HA, with 3xHA positioned at position S898 in ECL4 of CFTR.

sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by immunofluorescence in CFBE cells; L3/L12 confirm no disruption of protein folding or trafficking. Functional channel activity not directly re-measured in the tagged construct but trafficking to PM is intact.
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly states the FLAG tag was inserted between Asn901 and Ser902 in the fourth extracellular loop of full-length CFTR. Python confirms seq[900]='N' and seq[901]='S', matching the paper exactly. Position 901 is 22 residues from TM7 end (879) and 17 residues from TM8 start (918), well clear of both TM boundaries. L2 and L3 independently corroborate the same junction in the same ECL4 of full-length membrane-anchored CFTR. Full-length CFTR (WT and F508del) expressed in CFBE cells from a doxycycline-inducible lentiviral vector; FLAG octapeptide (DYKDDDDK) inserted between Asn901 and Ser902 in ECL4 to create a traffic reporter construct (mCherry-Flag-CFTR). Construct showed significant surface expression after 24–48 h induction.

sources.claim: Additionally, a Flag sequence (DYKDDDDK) was inserted between Asn901 and Ser902, i.e., in the fourth extracellular loop of CFTR ( Fig. 1a–c ).

sites.rationale: L7 reports CRISPR knock-in of HiBiT into ECL4 of full-length endogenous CFTR at two candidate positions, confirming the loop tolerates an 11-aa tag insertion and reaches the cell surface. No residue number is named in the clip, so the site is reported at region level (ECL4, residues 880–917) without a pinned junction. This is a third independent modality (CRISPR knock-in) confirming ECL4 tolerates extracellular tags. CRISPR/Cas9-mediated knock-in of HiBiT into ECL4 of endogenous WT-CFTR at two candidate positions investigated for bioluminescence-based quantification of total and surface CFTR levels (lytic and extracellular assays). No specific residue numbers are named in the clip.

sources.claim: We investigated two potential positions for CRISPR/Cas9-mediated knock-in of HiBiT in the ECL4 of WT-CFTR ( Fig 1A ) for bioluminescence-based quantification of both total endogenous levels (lytic assay) and live-cell detection of WT-CFTR in the PM (extracellular assay).

literature_notes: Three extracellular sites are supported by the ledger, all in ECL4 (topology 880–917). Site 1 (N901, FLAG) is the best-evidenced: two independent papers (L1, L2) name the exact junction 'between Asn901 and Ser902' in full-length membrane-anchored CFTR, and L3/L12 confirm no disruption of folding or trafficking. Site 2 (H897/S898, 3xHA) is named at residue level by L4 and corroborated by L12. Site 3 (HiBiT, ECL4) is region-level only from L7; L8 is even less specific and was not used as the primary clip. The other extracellular loops (ECL1 94–124, ECL2 219–222, ECL3 325–347, ECL5 1012, ECL6 1122–1126) have no ledger-supported insertions and were not proposed. ECL2 (4 aa), ECL5 (1 aa), and ECL6 (5 aa) are too short for a ~15-aa tag regardless. The N-terminus (residues 1–77, intracellular) and C-terminus (residues 1148–1480, intracellular) are both cytoplasmic; mCherry (L6, L11) and SpyTag (L9, L10) fusions there are intracellular and recorded in other_positions.
